item.title: Tonale 1.0.1
item.description:
## Tonale 1.0.1
- **Sync no longer stalls on larger uploads.** A batch of many changes was refused by the server and then shown as "waiting to upload" forever. Refused changes are now tried again from your library, and the few that still cannot be uploaded are shown as such. - Local files whose tags are empty sync cleanly.

item.title: Tonale 1.0.0
item.description:
## Tonale 1.0.0
- **Xin Account and sync.** Sign in with an email code, a password, Apple or Google, and keep your playlists and saved filters in sync across Macs. Signing in also signs in XHelpers Pro on the same Mac. - **Local files are recognized by content.** A moved or renamed file, or the same file on another Mac, stays connected to its playlists. - **Find Missing Files…** reconnects files that moved, and **Find Duplicates…** merges copies of the same file. - **Files & Folders** replaces "Folders" for local audio and video sources, and adding a folder now imports both its audio and its video. - **Add from YouTube…** takes video and playlist links in one sheet. - **Settings** has a sidebar with a pane for each source and for Account & Sync. - Clearer empty pages, brighter sidebar items, correct one-item wording ("1 song", not "1 songs"), and Tab moves between sign-in fields.
